legal.short: Test only inside an authorized scope. Observe § 202a-c StGB / the CFAA. This notice is not a substitute for Oversight.
legal.full:
LEGAL NOTICE
Pentests and bug-bounty work WITHOUT written or public authorization are A CRIME (§ 202a-c of the German Criminal Code; the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) in the United States).
Active work runs only with confirmed Human Oversight and a concrete target inside the scope. This notice does not replace Oversight and is not a substitute for a human decision.
Default-deny: an empty allowlist means no target and no run. No destructive attacks are performed. Optional active steps run only after an explicit approval.
legal.not_substitute: This notice does not replace Oversight and is not a substitute for a human decision.
scope.default_deny: Default-deny: with nothing on the allowlist there is no target and no run.
oversight.confirm: I confirm that the target is authorized and that I am permitted to test it.
oversight.active_steps: Human Oversight: I, the responsible person, confirm approval of this active/offensive run against the authorized target, and I am demonstrably permitted to test it.
oversight.active_legal: LEGAL NOTICE: Active or offensive security tests are permitted only with the owner's explicit authorization. Unauthorized access to, interception of, or probing of data is a crime (§ 202a-c of the German Criminal Code; the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) in the United States). This notice does not replace Oversight.
login.title: Sign in
login.hint: There is no default password. The hash lives only in the environment, not in the repository.
login.error_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait and try again.
login.error_csrf: The sign-in from another site was rejected.
assets.title: Own assets
assets.heading: Opt-in checks: TLS and security headers
assets.notice: Default-deny: only read-only, harmless checks run (TLS certificate, protocol, cipher, HTTP security headers), and only against assets you have explicitly confirmed as your own. No active or offensive payloads.
assets.confirm_own: I confirm that this is my own asset and that I am authorized.
assets.locked: Without an ownership confirmation the asset stays locked (default-deny).
assets.no_checks: No checks have been run yet.
trash.title: Trash
trash.heading: Trash – archived targets
trash.body: Targets removed from the active list live here. This is a soft delete: nothing was erased. Scopes, findings, scan history, WLAN data, and reports stay in the database. The queen keeps her knowledge. Archived targets are excluded from active scans until they are restored.
history.title: Run history
history.heading: Run history and export index
history.exports_hint: Every report and export that was produced, with a download link.
reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: Fixed folder per queen under data/reports. PDF engine: {engine}.
home.pitch: An orchestrated security framework: bug bounty and pentest, protection and hardening, reverse engineering. One process, one port, one address.
home.footer: All and One · Red · Blue · Yellow
notfound.title: I do not know this route.
notfound.body: Red, Blue, and Yellow stay on their own paths. The hub and the neural brain are the safe entrances.
queen.red.name: Red Queen
queen.red.summary: Bug bounty and pentest inside a tight scope. Active work only with an allowlist and Oversight. Default-deny: no target, no run.
queen.blue.name: Blue Queen
queen.blue.summary: Protection and hardening. Read-only by default. Active fixes only with Oversight; otherwise they are refused.
queen.yellow.name: Yellow Queen
queen.yellow.summary: Reverse engineering. Without Oversight the deep steps stay locked.
depth.net: Several targets or a network detected → Intensive is recommended.
depth.lab: Local or lab target → Light is recommended.
depth.external: External or unknown target → Intensive is recommended.
laeufe.title: Runs
laeufe.intro: Each dossier stays with Yellow. Red and Blue do not see these runs.
laeufe.empty: No run yet. Set scope and Oversight on the Yellow Queen first.

wlan.legal: Only with explicit authorization: an active engagement that has not been revoked (BSSID/SSID inside its time window) plus confirmed Oversight and ANTBB_WIFI=1. Without that approval every action stays locked (default-deny). Legal notice: § 202a-c StGB / the CFAA – unauthorized probing or interception of data is a crime. This notice does not replace Oversight. Deauth, evil-twin, and capture are operator-triggered only. There are no autonomous chains.
